commands.name: plugin_manifest_loader_smoke
command:
from DHI_v1.benchmark.plugin_task_loader import load_all_plugin_tasks
plans = load_all_plugin_tasks(
    "DHI_v1/benchmark/task_manifest.json",
    "DHI_v1/benchmark/fixtures/plugin_ecology/plugin_tool_registry.json",
)
assert len(plans) == 30
assert all(set(plan.required_tool_ids).issubset(plan.allowed_tool_ids) for plan in plans)
assert not any(plan.model_runs_allowed for plan in plans)
print("plugin task plans:", len(plans), "model runs enabled:", sum(plan.model_runs_allowed for plan in plans))
commands.output: plugin task plans: 30 model runs enabled: 0
